artifacts.linkage: PIE executable; talloc and libandroid-shmem linked statically

launcherContract.loaderEnv: PROOT_LOADER=libproot_loader.so (the compiled-in loader path is never used)

build.note: Built from source at APK build time; sizeBytes and sha256 for each artifact are filled in by the generateAlpineRuntimeManifest Gradle task

changes: Recover a unique uninitialized fork/clone child, including pending SIGSTOP entries and CLONE_THREAD tasks, using host Tgid/PPid/TracerPid from /proc; fail explicitly if recovery is missing or ambiguous
Handle Android outer-seccomp traps for fchmodat, chdir/fchdir/getcwd, faccessat/faccessat2, renameat2, and guest identity calls inside PRoot's seccomp event path
Bind System V shm calls to libandroid-shmem explicitly when targeting API levels below 26
